SRMV Swami Shivanandha Higher Secondary School — Higher Secondary | 2015 – 2017
Vidhya Vikas Matric Higher Secondary School — Secondary | 2015

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
• Supported timely and accurate processing of payroll with strong SLA adherence. 
• Improved payroll accuracy through structured validation and internal audit checks.
• Trained and mentored new hires to become productive payroll team members.
• Recognized for accuracy, compliance, ownership, and process improvement.

LANGUAGES
Tamil • English

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Primary Payroll Platform: Finesse
Primary Payroll Software: Paychex

Subject Matter Expert with 4.11 years of experience in US payroll processing. Experienced in payroll operations, pre- and post-payroll
validation, garnishments, payroll adjustments, tax/rate updates, off-cycle and bonus payrolls, 401(k) deductions, payroll audits,
reconciliation, client communication, and discrepancy resolution. Hands-on experience with Paychex and strong understanding of the end-
to-end US payroll lifecycle, with a focus on accuracy, compliance, SLA adherence, and process improvement.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS | Subject Matter Expert
2021 – Present
• Manage US payroll processing across multiple pay frequencies and validate payroll inputs before processing.
• Process employee setup, updates, terminations, earnings, deductions, adjustments, voids, reversals, and reissues in line with payroll
requirements
• Administer garnishments including child support, bankruptcy, and state tax levies based on applicable orders and payroll instructions. 
• Review and support payroll tax reporting by providing system-generated Forms 941, 940, and state reports to clients and downstream

teams; support tax/rate updates based on client-provided notices.
• Process off-cycle and bonus payrolls and validate gross-to-net and net-to-gross calculations.
• Review 401(k) deductions and flag contribution limits or deduction variances for client/team action.
• Processed 2% shareholder wages/deductions and maintain third-party disability pay for YTD reporting.
• Perform pre- and post-payroll audits, variance checks, reconciliations, and root-cause analysis to identify and correct discrepancies. 
• Resolved employee and client payroll inquiries through ticketing/internal tools and communicate clear resolutions within SLA.
• Train and onboard new payroll team members, support SOP maintenance, and contribute to process improvements.

CORE SKILLS
• US Payroll Processing
• Payroll Validation & Audits
• Garnishments & Deductions
• 401(k) & Benefits Deductions
• Payroll Adjustments, Voids & Reissues
• RCA / Issue Resolution
• Client & Employee Support
• Team Training & SOP Support

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

MS Excel • VLOOKUP • Pivot Tables
